connectors.gog.name: GOG
connectors.gog.errors.invalidId: This GOG game has an invalid identifier and cannot be launched.
connectors.gog.errors.infoMissing: Ludiary cannot find this game's files. It may have been uninstalled or moved: scan again.
connectors.gog.errors.noPlayTask: This game does not say how to open it. Open it from GOG Galaxy.
connectors.gog.errors.invalidTask: The game's launch data is not valid, so Ludiary will not open it. Open it from GOG Galaxy.
connectors.gog.errors.unsupportedExecuta: This game opens with something other than a program (.exe), which Ludiary does not launch. Open it from GOG Galaxy.
connectors.gog.login.title: Sign in to GOG
connectors.gog.login.body:
Press “Open the page”: GOG opens in a new tab. Sign in there; Ludiary never sees your password.
When it finishes you will see an almost blank page: copy its full address from the browser bar.
Come back to this tab and press “Paste”.
connectors.gog.error.code: The code has expired or was already used. Sign in again and paste the new address.
connectors.gog.error.expired: GOG has signed you out. Reconnect the account.
connectors.gog.error.wishlist: GOG did not let Ludiary read your wishlist. Try again later; your GOG connection is still active.
connectors.gog.errors.galaxyMissing: GOG Galaxy is needed to install this game. Install it from gog.com or download the installer from your gog.com library.
connectors.gog.disconnect.hint: Ludiary deletes its GOG session from this computer. To sign out everywhere, change your password at gog.com.
connectors.gog.launch.clientHint: Galaxy syncs your cloud saves and tracks achievements. If Galaxy is not installed, the game opens directly. If a game does not open this way, choose "Directly".
connectors.gog.launch.directHint: Faster and without opening Galaxy, but cloud saves are not synced.
